mapper.sql: PLAN_ID, PLAN_NO, PLAN_NAME, INVESTMENT_TYPE, PLAN_AMOUNT, INVESTED_AMOUNT, EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE, ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE, RISK_LEVEL, PLAN_STATUS, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_DESCRIPTION, APPROVAL_COMMENTS, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, CREATED_BY, CREATED_BY_NAME, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_BY_NAME, UPDATED_TIME, DELETE_FLAG, REMARK
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN ( PLAN_ID, PLAN_NO, PLAN_NAME, INVESTMENT_TYPE, PLAN_AMOUNT, INVESTED_AMOUNT, EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE, ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE, RISK_LEVEL, PLAN_STATUS, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_DESCRIPTION, APPROVAL_COMMENTS, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, CREATED_BY, CREATED_BY_NAME, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_BY_NAME, UPDATED_TIME, DELETE_FLAG, REMARK ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{planNo}, #{planName}, #{investmentType}, #{planAmount}, #{investedAmount}, #{expectedReturnRate}, #{actualReturnRate}, #{riskLevel}, #{planStatus}, #{planStartDate}, #{planEndDate}, #{planDescription}, #{approvalComments}, #{companyId}, #{companyName}, #{createdBy}, #{createdByName}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedByName}, #{updatedTime}, #{deleteFlag}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
SELECT FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE PLAN_NO = #{planNo} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
SELECT FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE PLAN_STATUS = #{planStatus} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE INVESTMENT_TYPE = #{investmentType} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND PLAN_STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING') ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN SET INVESTED_AMOUNT = #{investedAmount}, REMAINING_AMOUNT = PLAN_AMOUNT - #{investedAmount}, UPDATED_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId}

mapper.select: SELECT PLAN_STATUS AS status, COUNT(1) AS count FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY PLAN_STATUS
SELECT INVESTMENT_TYPE AS investmentType, COUNT(1) AS count FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY INVESTMENT_TYPE

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draftCount, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submittedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 'EXECUTING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS executingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, SUM(PLAN_AMOUNT) AS totalPlanAmount, SUM(INVESTED_AMOUNT) AS totalInvestedAmount, SUM(REMAINING_AMOUNT) AS totalRemainingAmount FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
SELECT FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND PLAN_STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING') AND PLAN_END_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + #{days} ORDER BY PLAN_END_DATE ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND PLAN_STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING') AND PLAN_END_DATE < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY PLAN_END_DATE ASC
